visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short brown hair and round glasses, dressed in a crisp white collared shirt and dark trousers, stands in a well-lit hotel room. She holds a rectangular yellow and green snack box, gesturing with her free hand as she speaks towards the camera. The background reveals a modern wooden desk with a minimalist desk lamp, a large wall-mounted flat-screen television, and heavy grey curtains near a window. (2) The camera focuses on the desk surface where the yellow box is placed. The woman's hands are seen opening the lid, revealing individual green and red snack packets neatly arranged inside. She brings her hands together in a traditional 'thank you' gesture with a warm, appreciative smile on her face. (3) The woman turns away from the desk, walking a few steps across the beige carpeted floor of the room before returning to the desk. She picks up a small, dark ceramic jar. The lighting remains soft and natural from the window, supplemented by the warm glow of the indoor lamp. (4) A close-up shot shows the interior of the dark jar, which contains dark, loose-leaf tea. The woman's finger points inside the jar to emphasize the contents. No other characters are visible in this specific environment. (5) Standing by the desk again, the woman holds a single green snack packet from the box, looking directly into the lens. Multiple text overlays with the word 'Coffee' in Chinese characters appear around her in a playful, repetitive manner. Her facial expression is expressive and animated as she continues her story. (6) The video transitions to a static white brand information card. A minimalist logo with 'DRX' is centered at the top. Below the logo, various contact details including social media handles, a phone number, and two specific addresses in Taipei and New Taipei are clearly displayed in clean black text.
